findings.message: Blocking sybil signals exist but reputation, ranking, or payout controls are not fully paused.
findings.remediation: Apply quarantine, suppress leaderboard rank, pause payout eligibility, and open a manual review ticket.

findings.message: Three or more accounts share a device fingerprint inside the same review window.
findings.remediation: Quarantine the cluster and suppress leaderboard movement until reviewed.

findings.message: Reviewer and submitter relationships form a high-score ring across bounty projects.
findings.remediation: Suppress review-derived reputation and route the cluster to trust-and-safety review.

findings.message: Multiple reputation accounts share the same payout handle.
findings.remediation: Pause payout eligibility and require identity review before reputation points affect bounty access.

findings.message: Several endorsements were created immediately after signup.
findings.remediation: Delay endorsement credit until accounts age past the configured trust window.

findings.message: The cluster gained enough reputation to affect rankings or bounty eligibility while risk signals are present.
findings.remediation: Hold reputation deltas until the cluster review is resolved.

findings.message: A non-seed account invited multiple high-velocity reputation accounts.
findings.remediation: Require manual review before granting invitation-derived reputation boosts.
